title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Sunday 22 November, 9:53am.** The three standouts right now: the **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at £139.99** (its record low), the **Ring Battery Video Doorbell and Indoor Camera bundle at £39.99**, and the **Sonos Ace headphones at £199** (£150 off). All three are at Amazon.

Black Friday 2026 is five days away, on Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. This morning we added the Sonos Ace at £199, the Amazon Kids Tablet 8 at a new low of £124 and the Bose Smart Soundbar at £329, and took off the Amazon Ember 65-inch Mini-LED, the Revlon One-Step and the Nothing Ear (3a), which we couldn't re-confirm today. Prices were reported on 21 and 22 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy. Many Amazon prices need Prime: a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: Wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light and 32GB of storage. Still £139.99 in TechRadar's Amazon picks this morning (22 November), the lowest price it has been. See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free doorbell plus a plug-in indoor camera for about what the doorbell alone usually costs, still £39.99 this morning (22 November). The 'was' price adds the two list prices together, but £40 for both is still excellent. See our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Sonos Ace Noise Cancelling Headphones
deals.note: Sonos' over-ear headphones with strong noise cancelling and the ability to take over your Sonos soundbar's audio. £150 off at Amazon (TechRadar, late on 21 November), well under the £279 to £299 they usually sell for. See our [AirPods guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) if you prefer Apple.

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: Oral-B's magnetic iO brush with pressure sensor and three modes for under £50, about a third of its RRP. The cheapest way into the iO range. See our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Colorsoft (16GB)
deals.note: Amazon's colour-screen Kindle, great for comics, cookbooks and highlighting. TechRadar lists it at £144.99 today, and Which?'s price data puts that at its cheapest ever. A [Kindle Unlimited trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) adds free books. See our [Kindle guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm)
deals.note: Garmin's top multisport watch with maps and a torch, still £484.99 in T3's picks (21 November), which TechRadar calls its lowest-ever price. Which?'s six-month low on Amazon was about £553. Check the case size and screen type on the listing.

deals.name: Sony WH-1000XM6 Noise Cancelling Headphones
deals.note: Sony's current flagship over-ear headphones, £101 off. Some of the best noise cancelling you can buy, with long battery life. If £298 is too much, the older XM4 are £179.

deals.name: Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: Philips' premium sonic brush with app tracking and a charging glass. TechRadar reports £109.99 at Amazon today, a record low. See our [Oral-B guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) if you prefer a rotating head.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L Air Fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: The two-drawer Ninja most families buy. It was £125 to £128 last Black Friday, so this already beats it. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Kids Tablet 8
deals.note: A child-proof tablet with a two-year worry-free guarantee and a year of Amazon Kids+ content. It dropped again to £124 this morning (22 November), down from £149 yesterday. The Kids Tablet 11 is £169. A strong Christmas present for ages 3 to 7.

deals.name: Blink Outdoor 4 Camera + free Blink Mini 2K+
deals.note: A battery-powered outdoor camera plus an indoor plug-in camera for £24.99 (TechRadar, 21 November). Saving clips needs a Blink subscription or a Sync Module with a USB stick. See our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Bone Conduction Headphones
deals.note: Open-ear headphones that sit in front of your ears, so you can still hear traffic on a run or ride. £43 off at Amazon today (20 November), which TechRadar calls a record low. Sound is thinner than normal earbuds, so these are for exercise rather than music on the sofa.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Origin Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's cheapest current cordless at £130 off, still in Amazon's Black Friday picks this morning (20 November). Fine for flats and quick tidy-ups. More in our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Bose Smart Dolby Atmos Soundbar
deals.note: Bose's compact Atmos soundbar, back on TechRadar's list this morning (22 November) at £329, about a third off. A close rival to the Sonos Beam below. See our [TV guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Sonos Beam (Gen 2) Soundbar
deals.note: A compact Dolby Atmos soundbar that suits most TVs up to 65 inches. £110 off at Amazon this evening (TechRadar, 21 November). See our [TV guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) for a screen to go with it.

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next Bean-to-Cup Coffee Machine
deals.note: Fresh-ground espresso, cappuccino and latte at the touch of a button, over £200 off. A good mid-range bean-to-cup that saves pod costs. More in our [coffee machine guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Ember 50-inch 4K TV
deals.note: Amazon's own 4K TV with Fire TV built in, at its lowest price yet. A sensible bedroom or second-room TV. More in our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Oura Ring 5
deals.note: A sleep and recovery tracker you wear as a ring. The black and silver finishes are £299 (£100 off); Gold, Brushed Silver, Stealth and Deep Rose are £399. The app needs a monthly membership after the first month, so factor that in.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K (latest model)
deals.note: Its lowest price yet at Amazon, re-confirmed this morning (22 November). Get this rather than the 4K Max (£46.99) unless you have a Wi-Fi 6E router.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (newest model, 16GB)
deals.note: The basic Kindle with a glare-free screen and adjustable light, at a record-low £119.99. TechRadar expects this to be its lowest price until next year's Prime Day. The Paperwhite above is worth the extra £20 for its bigger, waterproof screen. Pair it with a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku). See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: Cooks in glass dishes you can serve from and store leftovers in. Under last year's Black Friday price of £117. Good for one or two people.

deals.name: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Eau de Toilette 100ml gift set
deals.note: A safe gift for men: 40% off at John Lewis this afternoon (T3, 21 November). Amazon sells the same set, so compare before you buy. See our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: LEGO Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: A Christmas build that doubles as a decoration year after year. 20% off is a fair price for a seasonal set. More in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
deals.note: It needs to arrive by 1 December, so there's no point waiting. £22.99 at John Lewis today (22 November); Amazon has also sold it for about this, so compare before you buy. Every set is in our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

body:
## Tech

The best tech deals right now are on Amazon's own devices: the Kindle Paperwhite Signature at £139.99, the Kindle Colorsoft at its lowest-ever £144.99, the standard Kindle at £119.99, the Ring doorbell bundle at £39.99 and a Blink Outdoor 4 camera with a free Blink Mini for £24.99. The Fire TV Stick 4K is a record-low £31.99; the 4K Max (£46.99) is still about £9 above its best, so we've taken it off for now. The Garmin fēnix 8 at £484.99 is the standout watch deal, and the Oura Ring 5 is £299 in black or silver. Amazon's own Ember 50-inch 4K TV is at its lowest price yet at £269.99, and the Kids Tablet 8 has dropped to £124. For audio, the Sonos Ace headphones are £199 (£150 off), Sony's WH-1000XM6 are £298, the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 are a record-low £126, and for TVs the Sonos Beam (Gen 2) is £339 and the Bose Smart Soundbar £329. The AirPods 5 are £119 at Amazon (EE customers can get £99), so see our AirPods guide before you buy.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

Ninja's air fryers are already at or below last year's Black Friday prices: the AF300UK dual-zone is £119 and the Crispi glass air fryer £99. The Dyson V8 Origin at £199.99 (Amazon) is the standout cordless vacuum deal, and the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next bean-to-cup coffee machine is £379, over £200 off. The Sage Bambino Plus is £349 at Amazon, but that isn't its lowest ever, so it's not on the list. We've taken off the Roborock Qrevo S Pro until we can re-confirm its price.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

Electric toothbrushes are the best beauty deals today: the Oral-B iO Series 3 is £49.99 (from £175) and the Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 is a record-low £109.99, both at Amazon. The Revlon One-Step volumiser is £25 at Currys (we couldn't re-confirm Amazon's price today). For gifts, John Lewis has the Boss Bottled 100ml gift set at £54.60 (40% off), and Superdrug's Black Friday fragrance event runs until 1 December. Amazon sells most of the same sets, so [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. The Lego Festive Gingerbread House is £28 at Amazon, a good one to build together in December, and the Lego Star Wars advent calendar is £22.99 at John Lewis. The Nintendo Switch 2 Sports Resort bundle is £399 at Amazon. For younger children, the Amazon Kids Tablet 8 is £124 with a two-year guarantee. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) and [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices to wait for.
